resources.string: Connect or disconnect Cat Client from your home screen

Cat Client is a free VPN service that routes your device traffic through VPN servers when connected.

- We do not ask for account details in this app.
- The app may process technical connection information needed to provide the VPN, such as connection status, traffic usage, diagnostics, and service errors.
- The app stores usage counters locally on your device.
- Third-party network providers may process connection metadata required to deliver internet traffic.
- You are responsible for how you use this service. Any illegal activity performed through the service is not the responsibility of Cat Client.
- Do not use the service for unlawful activity. Service availability, speed, and privacy protections are provided without warranty.

With Orbot running on this phone, all traffic leaves through 127.0.0.1:9050 — a path that depends on no server of ours. It is slower, but it is what saves you when nothing else connects. The switch alone is not enough: Orbot has to be actually listening.
Off — the next connection uses the normal path (%1$s).
On — not checked yet (%1$s). Press «check now».
Orbot answered on %1$s (%2$d ms) — the next connection goes through Tor.

On = if the normal path fails twice in a row, the next connection goes through Orbot, and ten minutes later the normal path gets one more try. A single success resets the run, so a healthy path is not moved for no reason. With Orbot closed this switch does nothing at all (it never dials a dead port).
On — on the normal path: %1$d consecutive failures of %2$d (at the threshold the next connection goes through Tor).

Free Node.js host. «⚡ Install automatically» puts the panel on your server with your KataBump key, tests it from this phone and adds the configs (IP:port, no TLS). Needs a renewal every 4 days — the app counts down and reminds you. Warning: KataBump rules forbid proxies; the server may be deleted.
Builds from GitHub. «⚡ Build automatically» makes a private GitHub repository with the panel; you pick it on Lucity (3 taps, shown step by step), then «✍️ Add my panel». TLS configs on 443.
